title: Nonconvex Gradient Gibbs States and Free Energy
exact_target: Develop a general theory of free energy and Gibbs states for nonconvex gradient interactions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001118 (OWR-2493-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Interplay of Analysis and Probability in Physics (2008), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2008/55, pp. 3065--3138; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 44.
non-convex gradient models; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The report discusses perturbations of a Gaussian potential and a low-temperature RG breakthrough. The question asks what can be proved more broadly; it does not assert universal uniqueness or strict convexity for every nonconvex interaction.
